consequence.statement: Metric collection configurations that reference `lbipam_services_unsatisfied_total` will not receive the renamed metric; monitoring dashboards and alerting rules using the old metric name will stop functioning.

original.statement: The metric `lbipam_services_unsatisfied_total` has been renamed to `lbipam_services_unsatisfied`.

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, the LB-IPAM unsatisfied-services metric is exposed as `lbipam_services_unsatisfied` instead of `lbipam_services_unsatisfied_total`. Monitoring queries, dashboards or alerting rules that reference the old name should be checked against the new name.
consequence.remediation: Update any Prometheus queries, recording rules, dashboards or alerts that reference `lbipam_services_unsatisfied_total` so they use `lbipam_services_unsatisfied`.

corrected.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the metric `lbipam_services_unsatisfied_total` is renamed to `lbipam_services_unsatisfied`. Monitoring queries, dashboards or alerts that use the old name should be reviewed (behavior-change, review).

decision.reason: [ev-9a62461ebaa9] says only that the metric `lbipam_services_unsatisfied_total` was renamed to `lbipam_services_unsatisfied`, listed under "Changed Metrics". So the review class behavior-change fits. The proposed statement goes further than the evidence by saying dashboards and alerting rules "will stop functioning". The evidence never says anything fails, so I rewrote the statement to describe only the rename and the need to check anything that references the old name.
